title.en: METR publishes a qualified assessment of Anthropic AI R&D acceleration
title.zhHans: METR 发布对 Anthropic AI 研发加速情况的有限评估

searchSummary.en: METR estimated roughly twice the historical rate of progress on specified tasks, with high uncertainty and extensive Anthropic redactions.
searchSummary.zhHans: METR 估计指定任务上的能力进展速率约为历史水平的两倍，但不确定性高，且 Anthropic 大幅删节证据。

summary.en: On November 5, METR published its high-access assessment of Anthropic AI R&D from August 12 to October 29. It estimated that progress on well-specified model tasks was around twice its March 2024–October 2025 rate, while a benchmark trend gave 1.9 times with a 95% interval of 1.5–2.8. METR said other causes may contribute and the true acceleration could be around 1.3 or 3 times. Anthropic redacted most evidence METR considered most informative, limiting public scrutiny; this is METR’s qualified assessment, not a fully reproducible result.
summary.zhHans: METR 于 11 月 5 日公布了针对 Anthropic 8 月 12 日至 10 月 29 日 AI 研发活动的高权限评估。它估计，指定任务上的模型能力进展速率约为 2024 年 3 月至 2025 年 10 月水平的两倍；一项基准指标估计为 1.9 倍，95% 区间为 1.5 至 2.8 倍。METR 指出其他因素可能参与作用，真实加速幅度也可能接近 1.3 倍或 3 倍。Anthropic 删节了 METR 认为最有信息量的大部分证据，限制了公众核查；这是有保留的评估，而非可完整复现的结论。

narrative.en: The event date is the public report, not the October assessment period. METR is an external evaluator with privileged access, but it is the originator of these estimates; press accounts repeating its numbers do not create a second independent measurement. Redactions and causal uncertainty preclude treating the estimate as established autonomous AI self-improvement.
narrative.zhHans: 事件日期为报告公开日，而非 10 月评估期。METR 是取得高权限资料的外部评估者，但它仍是这些估计的原始来源；媒体重复数字不构成第二次独立测量。删节与因果不确定性也使该估计不能被写成 AI 自主改进已经得到证实。

text.en: METR published a qualified estimate on November 5 of roughly doubled progress rate on specified tasks, with a 1.9x benchmark trend and wide uncertainty.
text.zhHans: METR 于 11 月 5 日发布有保留的估计：指定任务上的进展速率约翻倍，基准趋势约为 1.9 倍，不确定性较大。

text.en: Anthropic redacted much of the evidence METR found most informative; the true rate and the contribution of AI to it remain uncertain.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 删节了 METR 认为最有信息量的大量证据；实际速率及 AI 的贡献仍有不确定性。
